result:
Solution 1 is wrong. Since $K_5 - e$ contains $K_4$, any coloring with no blue $K_4$ has no blue $K_5 - e$, so $R(K_5, K_5-e) \geq R(K_5, K_4) = 25$. The claimed value 22 violates this bound.

Solutions 2 and 3 are also unsupported. Solution 2's 30 rests on hand-waved "degree counting" and an unverified construction. Solution 3's 34 cites "computer-assisted verification" without details. I can't confirm either value from memory, so I can't say either is the known exact value.

CHOICE: NONE
CONFIDENCE: 2
